source.notes: Served by docs.inceptionlabs.ai. Server https://api.inceptionlabs.ai. (docs.inceptionlabs.ai/api-reference/openapi.json is an unrelated Mintlify sample.)

model.title: Model
model.description: The model to use for the chat completion.

max_tokens.title: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: What sampling temperature to use, between 0.5 and 1. Higher values make the output more random; lower values make it more focused and deterministic. Values outside this range are reset to 0.75 and a `warning` is returned in the response.

stop.title: Stop
stop.description: A list of sequences where the API will stop generating further tokens. The returned text will not contain the stop sequences.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: A list of tools the model may call. Use this to provide functions the model can generate JSON arguments for.

diffusing.title: Diffusing
diffusing.description: Whether to show the diffusion effect in the streamed response.

extra_body.title: Extra Body
extra_body.description: Extra parameters passed to the model (OpenAI-compat passthrough).

realtime.title: Realtime
realtime.description: Enable flag for more realtime workloads that require lower TTFT/TTFAT.

response_format.title: Response Format
response_format.description: An object specifying the format that the model must output.

reasoning_summary.title: Reasoning Summary
reasoning_summary.description: Request a summary of the model's reasoning process.

reasoning_summary_wait.title: Reasoning Summary Wait
reasoning_summary_wait.description: Wait for all reasoning summaries to complete before finishing the response.

reasoning_effort.title: Reasoning Effort
reasoning_effort.description: Constrains the effort spent on reasoning before the model responds.

reasoning_summary.description: Summary of reasoning process if requested and available.

message.content: A diffusion language model is a type of language model that uses diffusion to generate text.

role.title: Role
role.description: The role of the message sender (system, user, assistant, tool, function).

content.title: Content
content.description: The content of the message, can be string or array of content items.

tool_calls.title: Tool Calls
tool_calls.description: The tool calls generated by the model.

tool_call_id.title: Tool Call Id
tool_call_id.description: The ID of the tool call this message is responding to (for role='tool').

include_usage.title: Include Usage
include_usage.description: If true, an additional chunk is streamed before the `data: [DONE]` message containing the token usage statistics for the entire request. Inside that chunk, `choices` is an empty array and the `usage` field is populated.

StreamOptions.title: StreamOptions
StreamOptions.description: Options for controlling streaming behavior. Only used when `stream=true`.

type.description: The type of response format being defined. Always `text`. The model responds with plain text and output is not constrained to JSON.
The type of response format being defined. Always `json_object`.
The type of response format being defined. Always `json_schema`.

finish_reason.description: The reason the model stopped generating tokens.

ReasoningSummary.description: Summary of the model's reasoning process.
ReasoningSummary.title: ReasoningSummary

name.description: The name of the function to call. Must be a-z, A-Z, 0-9, or contain underscores and dashes, with a maximum length of 64.

description.description: A description of what the function does, used by the model to choose when and how to call the function.

parameters.description: The parameters the function accepts, described as a JSON Schema object.

strict.description: Whether to enforce strict schema adherence when generating the function call. When true, the model output is constrained to match the `parameters` schema exactly.

name.description: The name of the response format. Must be a-z, A-Z, 0-9, or contain underscores and dashes, with a maximum length of 64.

description.description: A description of what the response format is for, used by the model to determine how to respond in the format.

schema.description: The schema for the response format, described as a JSON Schema object.

strict.description: Whether to enforce strict schema adherence when generating the output. When true, the model output is constrained to match the supplied `schema` exactly.

BearerAuth.description: API key provided as a Bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`. Get an API key at https://platform.inceptionlabs.ai.
